content:
The current incoming account_id is its current book entry. Its reference is a bank transmission identifier, which can differ from a platform payout label.

Same-amount incoming records remain separate transfers. Every trace has an incoming_id linking the evidence to exactly one transfer.

The advice result is available through the public traces resource after READY status.

title: Linking a bank trace to its incoming payment
